decisive_items: PET scan showed an intensely fludeoxyglucose-avid focus in the left anterior pelvis at the junction of the left and rectosigmoid colon, strongly suspicious for malignancy
new soft tissue thickening in the ascending colon near the cecum suggestive of a mass
response.rationale: PET-avid focus and mass-like thickening strongly favor malignancy over inflammatory conditions; high calprotectin is nonspecific and also seen in IBD, but the imaging findings are more specific for cancer.

rejected.why: Diffuse colitis and elevated calprotectin support IBD, but the PET-avid mass and focal thickening are more consistent with malignancy.
Paracolic haziness was a prior possible finding; current diffuse thickening and PET-avid focus are not typical for diverticulitis.
